integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, over-the-top action spectacle. A wide shot frames a sun-blasted street with heat shimmer and warm dusty daylight, lens flare grazing the lens. The protagonist stands centered, sunglasses on, coat tugged by wind. In extreme slow motion he deliberately removes his sunglasses, revealing cold, arrogant eyes, and stares directly into the lens with a flaunting, chilling smirk — the "Flash Glance." The camera holds nearly static with only a small slow push-in toward his face. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to an off-road pickup truck roaring into frame at full speed behind him, thundering straight toward his back; a quick cut to its charging grille as dust explodes from its tires. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts back to a medium shot: the truck is about to hit him, but he does not move an inch. Calmly he lifts one leg into a straight front kick meeting the oncoming hood. On contact, a single dramatic impact frame freezes the instant the truck touches his shoe tip — then it is launched straight up into the sky as if it were a lightweight toy model car, with a brief dynamic push-in emphasizing the kick. [Shot 4] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts to a low wide angle: the truck tumbles end over end high in the air, then bursts apart — body panels, glass, and metal fragments detonating outward and raining down across the frame in glittering slow motion, while nearby bystanders are knocked off their feet and flung by the shockwave. [Shot 5] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts to a medium-wide shot: the protagonist stands unmoved amid the storm of falling wreckage and scattered crowd, entirely composed. He snaps his sunglasses back on with a flick, then casually smooths his hair with one hand, settling into a confident pose as debris settles around him. A title card reading "无敌终章 (The Final Flex)" appears on screen.

overall_soundscape: A deep truck-engine roar builds and rushes toward the camera, then a colossal metallic impact with a sharp shockwave crack. Metal panels, glass, and debris clatter and rain down across the pavement while bystanders shout wordlessly and tumble, all under a low wind and settling-dust ambience.

non_diegetic_music: Heavy percussion-driven orchestral action score at a driving tempo, dropping to a near-silent suspended note at the impact frame, then swelling with brass and low strings as the debris falls, ending on a single confident hit.
